note: DT.1c: every TypeScript interface and field-only class and every Go struct with an exported field or embed carries one SCHEMA_FIELDS cell (code-domain wire::ModelSchema, format ts / go) listing its declared fields by their JSON name. TS: a quoted key unquoted, `?` -> required false, an index signature -> open, method signatures skipped, `extends` the base names; a class qualifies only when its body is fields plus at most a constructor (AccountStore, with a private field and a method, gets none). Go: names by encoding/json's tag rules (rename, omitempty, `-` skipped, `-,` named "-", `,string` typed string, untagged = the Go name), unexported fields skipped, an untagged embed is `extends`, binding / validate required -> bind; a struct with no exported field and no embed (cache) gets none.

expect_cells.note: an index signature leaves the model open
a field-only class (fields plus a constructor) is a model
the json tag name, not the Go name
no tag -> the Go field name
an untagged embed promotes its fields
`,string` encodes the int64 as a JSON string

forbid.note: a field-only class stays a CLASS
